mdait.welcome.message:
mdait is not configured yet.

Create a configuration file to get started. If your documents are already translated, you can adopt them right after setup.

[$(gear) Create mdait.json](command:mdait.setup.createConfig)

Already have an mdait.json elsewhere? [Select it](command:mdait.setup.openExistingConfig). Something not working? [Diagnose setup](command:mdait.setup.diagnose).
mdait.welcome.start.message:
How do you want to start?

Starting a fresh translation:

[$(sync) Initial Sync](command:mdait.status.sync.initial)

Already have translated documents (no mdait markers yet)? Adopt them without overwriting — optionally building the glossary and translation memory together:

[$(cloud-download) ✨Adopt Existing Translations](command:mdait.adopt.run)
